subject.title: WhatsApp: Add support for querying message reactions

question: Should passive WhatsApp reaction hooks move under https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/79996 while this issue remains canonical for historical query and storage semantics?
rationale: The current request combines passive events, agent visibility, and historical retrieval, which require different public contracts, privacy decisions, and validation paths.

options.title: Split hook and query ownership
options.body: Use the narrower issue for passive add/remove events and retain this issue for generic reaction lookup and historical storage.

options.title: Keep one umbrella
options.body: Design hooks, agent visibility, persistence, and queries together under this issue.

options.title: Defer historical queries
options.body: Implement passive hooks first and leave query/storage work open until a reliable canonical data source is selected.

recommendation.title: Split hook and query ownership
recommendation.body: Use the narrower issue for passive add/remove events and retain this issue for generic reaction lookup and historical storage.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged history spans WhatsApp reaction policy, approval-reaction routing, and current inbound behavior.
